title: Identification and Immune Landscape Analysis of Fatty Acid Metabolism-related Genes Associated with Rheumatoid Arthritis.
authors: Zhou, Zhongyang; Luo, Rong; Shao, Lan
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦类风湿关节炎脂肪酸代谢相关基因的鉴定与免疫微环境分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Background: Dysfunction of fatty acid metabolism plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA). This study aimed to screen for Hub genes involved in fatty acid metabolism that contribute to the inflammatory state of RA synovium. Methods: Four mRNA microarray datasets for RA were integrated into an expression matrix as a test dataset. One RNA-seq and five microarray datasets were preprocessed as validation datasets. Immune cell infiltration combined with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) were used to feature infiltrated cells and their correlation with candidate genes in RA. Five machine learning algorithms were applied to Hub genes screening. Temporal, immuno-efficacy, drug target prediction, molecular docking, ceRNA, and transcription factors networks analyses were conducted to elucidate the association of the Hub genes with RA. Immunofluorescence assay was performed in Collagen-Induced Arthritis (CIA) mouse, and qPCR and Western blot were applied to TNFalpha or IL-6 treated MH7A cells to reveal the potential roles of the proinflammatory cytokines on Hub genes expression in RA synovium. Results: Three Hub genes with better diagnostic efficiency were screened, with PDK1 and XBP1 up-regulated and ACACB down-regulated in RA. These genes were associated with immune cells infiltration and immuno-efficacy in RA, and their expression patterns showed time-dependent characteristics during disease progression. Mechanistically, MALAT1, NEAT1 and FOXC1 were involved in the regulation of PDK1, XBP1 and ACACB expression, and TNFalpha or IL-6 treatment mimicked their expression phenotypes in RA. Conclusion: Our study identified PDK1, XBP1 and ACACB as the Hub genes from the fatty acid metabolic pathway and indicated that PDK1, XBP1 and ACACB might play key roles in the pathogenesis of RA synovium.
abstract_zh: 背景：脂肪酸代谢功能障碍在类风湿关节炎（RA）的发病机制中发挥关键作用。本研究旨在筛选参与脂肪酸代谢、促进RA滑膜炎症状态的Hub基因。方法：将四个RA mRNA微阵列数据集整合为表达矩阵作为测试数据集。一个RNA-seq和五个微阵列数据集作为验证数据集进行预处理。结合免疫细胞浸润与加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），用于表征RA中浸润细胞及其与候选基因的相关性。应用五种机器学习算法进行Hub基因筛选。进行了时间序列、免疫效能、药物靶点预测、分子对接、ceRNA和转录因子网络分析，以阐明Hub基因与RA的关联。在胶原诱导关节炎（CIA）小鼠中进行免疫荧光检测，并对TNFalpha或IL-6处理的MH7A细胞应用qPCR和Western blot，以揭示促炎细胞因子在RA滑膜中对Hub基因表达的潜在作用。结果：筛选出三个具有较好诊断效能的Hub基因，其中PDK1和XBP1在RA中上调，ACACB下调。这些基因与RA中的免疫细胞浸润和免疫效能相关，其表达模式在疾病进展过程中表现出时间依赖性特征。机制上，MALAT1、NEAT1和FOXC1参与调控PDK1、XBP1和ACACB的表达，且TNFalpha或IL-6处理模拟了它们在RA中的表达表型。结论：本研究从脂肪酸代谢通路中鉴定出PDK1、XBP1和ACACB为Hub基因，并表明PDK1、XBP1和ACACB可能在RA滑膜的发病机制中发挥关键作用。
